case_number: 2025 INSC 212; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 4036-4038 of 2024)
summary: Regularisation of temporary AEEs appointed 1990-1995; G.O.M. No. 234 of 2005 regularised services below last selected candidate; seniority dispute between pre- and post-Act of 1994 appointees; challenge to denial of seniority; High Court quashed G.O.M. No. 262 of 2006; appeal allowed to restore regularisation with clarification on seniority;
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh (Regulation of Appointments to Public Services and Rationalization of Staff Pattern and Pay Structure) Act, 1994
Andhra Pradesh Subordinate Service Rules, Rule 10(a)(i)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; regularisation under G.O.M. No. 234 of 2005 upheld; remanded for determination of seniority in accordance with law.
